scope: COH-T27 fixed180s receipt recovery, repair recipient only
interpretation: Observed host subprocess/validation spans are small relative to actor wall time. Remaining time includes model, host scheduling, context and coordination; telemetry does not isolate them. No CPU/IO bottleneck or token/cost claim.

Keep exact actor identity, deadline, semantic acceptance separation, per-message results, refusal/no-reset and stale-version checks.
